review.notes: Word-level diff of the PDF text layer against the OCR markdown for all 11 physical pages, a whole-document digit-token inventory (table values all present; residual tokens are page numerals 789-799 and tokenizer artifacts), code-fence scan (both ```txt prompt blocks balanced), and 300/220 dpi renders of physical p.2, p.3 and p.4 footnote areas plus p.6 'Wenyiil' and p.9 'Ondřej Bojar' cells. Footnote markers $^{1}$-$^{8}$ survive in the OCR while all eight footnote bodies were dropped; they are restored as paragraphs after the paragraphs carrying the markers, following the north-small-translate pattern. The remaining word diffs are soft-hyphen/line-break artifacts (non-English, step-by-step, post-editing, long-context, xComet-XL, instruction-following, state-of-the-art, CommandA-WMT, mT5-XXL, Chi-kiu).
